item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 4:00 PM, 23 August 2026(Sunday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Pampanga, Quezon(Infanta, Real, General Nakar, Perez, Alabat, Mauban, Calauag, Quezon, Sampaloc), Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Miguel, San Ildefonso, San Rafael), Bataan(Samal, Abucay, Orani, Hermosa, Dinalupihan, Morong, Balanga, Bagac) and Batangas(Tanauan, Santo Tomas, Talisay) within the next 2-3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in Zambales(Cabangan, Botolan, Candelaria, Masinloc, Palauig, Iba, San Marcelino), Nueva Ecija(Gabaldon), Tarlac(San Jose, Capas), Rizal(Binangonan, Cardona, Jala-Jala, Pililla) and Laguna(Mabitac, Pakil, Famy, Siniloan, Santa Maria, Pangil) which may persist within 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
